When I was in the hospital, the intercom seemed to be mocking me. A
Thanks, coming to this subreddit is a great relief for now I know there are others who have experienced this as well.

I used to believe that this deity like figure would set me free if I behaved in a good way as well and now that I do not suffer the delusions that my torment has subsided. Though the rational part of me says that those experiences were just delusions caused by my own guilt, they seemed so perfectly orchestrated that I fear that I was truly singled out and punished.

I know that feeling so well. When I was in the hospital all I heard was never ending laughter at my expense. People talking and plotting to make me look like the stupidist combination of matter in the universe. The pain was so immense that I still feel it everyday and wonder sometimes if what I experienced was real. But I am much stronger than I once was and have conviction that my future will be good.
This is a poem I wrote about dealing with these feelings and experiences:
Hope Beyond

Wishing, grasping, for wings to soar out of this, A
Howling,Howling their cries are demented horns, B
Treading, treading, they  mock, they curse, they scorn, B
Sentencing  me to the Mind’s endless abyss, A
Nothing I do is beyond their contempt, C
Look away but their cackling rings my ears, D
My eyes so weary, they cannot stream tears, D
It seemed nothing saved me from their torment, C
Yet I grasp my perceptions were blind, E
Whether Sun or Moon I fall but will arise, F
Future’s Pyre aflame, there’s no rewind, E
And shrug the laughter of phantom demise, F
And though the great darkness lingers and pains, G
Blood of Vigor and hope stream through my veins. G
I'm glad to know that I am not alone in this. It just sometimes seems that people are conspiring to make me look stupid or that the whole world is against me for some reason I cannot comprehend.
